text:
Anya: heads up — saw a spike in funcall JSON failures on the AWQ quantized variant during the nightly evals :eyeglasses:
Mohit: what kind of failures? examples?
Anya: mostly malformed tool args, extra backslashes and occasionally trailing commas. repro from eval harness: 
```
{"tool":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"redwood inference\"}",}
```
Anya: baseline fp16 and GPTQ outputs are clean, AWQ seems to inject escaping and sometimes a trailing comma.
Samira: that looks like double-escaping of the inner JSON string + stray token insert. any pattern around prompt templates or tokenizers?
Anya: reproducible on the small chat-suite tests that call tools with structured args. non-deterministic but high enough rate to affect our funcall pass rate (drop ~3.2% on nightly).
Mohit: can you paste the eval run id and seed? I'll kick off a bisect across quant config variants (per-channel vs per-tensor, blocksize 128/256)
Anya: run id nightly-2026-03-19-09, seed 42. failing examples attached in the run artifact (link: https://internal/runs/nightly-2026-03-19-09/artifacts/escape-fails).
CI-bot: test-suite/funcalls — AWQ-variant — 17 failed, see ./ci/logs/awq-funcalls-1813429012.log :rotating_light:
Leo: @Mohit could be detokenization differences (mixed-charset escapes) or a regression in our AWQ exporter that changed special-token logits.
Mohit: plan: 1) confirm with a deterministic decode (topk=1, temperature=0) to rule out sampling; 2) run bisect across quant configs; 3) diff token-level logits between fp16 and AWQ on failing step (save top 50 token probs).
Samira: also try forcing byte-level detokenization vs standard to see if escaping changes. add a test where we run the same prompt and compare json.loads on the tool args string — count failures per model variant.
Anya: temporary mitigations: 1) apply postprocess json sanitizer on the agent side (strip trailing commas, unescape twice when pattern detected), 2) route critical funcalls to GPTQ or fp16 until fix. want to keep perf but not break customers.
Mohit: starting bisect now. baseline fp16 vs AWQ-8bit-perchannel vs AWQ-8bit-pertensor vs GPTQ-4bit. will push results in this thread.
Anya: thanks. also curious if FP8 trials showed anything similar last month?
Leo: FP8 had different failure modes (precision loss on numeric fields) but not escaping. this looks like tokenizer/detokenizer mismatch or an off-by-one in logits postprocessing.
Mohit: quick update — deterministic decode removes most variability but AWQ still emits extra backslashes in ~0.9% of cases. pushing log diffs to s3 and starting token-prob diffs.
Samira: adding a small unit test to the funcall harness: 
```bash
pytest tests/funcalls/test_escape.py -k awq -q
```
Samira: if anyone hits the failing artifact, please upload a minimal repro (prompt + model config + seed) so we can run locally.
Anya: tagging @Mohit for ownership, I'll open a follow-up with the mitigations and customer impact notes. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: issue created — INF-8935 "AWQ funcall escaping regression" — assigned to Mohit.
Mohit: got it. will update ETA after initial bisect (aiming EOD). :hammer:
Anya: thanks all — appreciate fast triage. :eyes:
